item: CoroCoro tag check + rewrite (save bytes $1FFD-$1FFF = 56 56 53)

item: Hot-spot effect icons (8 extra) and GG 0FD-199-F76 (JP)
tcrf: Eight additional icons, only two with unique effects; "S" icon = wave, the rest = quick page flip
verdict: GG verified: raises `ld d,$07` (03:6D18) to $0F. The table at 03:655D has 17 entries (index = effect + 1): effects 0-7 have eight distinct handlers (03:6642, 66AF, 66DC, 67D5, 6801, 6838, 68A4, 6901) and effects 8-15 ALL point to 03:6983, one raster routine that never tests the effect number, so the TCRF claim "S icon = wave, the rest = page flip" is not visible in the code (?). Re-run with an armed hot spot (WRAM poke of D643-D65C) and a real A press: effects 0-8 each executed their handler (tools/hotspot_effects.py); none of them ran in the v8 organic runs because the pointer never sat on an armed hot spot (03:6450 hit path: forced only). Icons rendered.
